name: Yakumo Ame
source: When [url=/c133400]Hashigo[/url] was hospitalized, she took care of him as an intern, but has now became an official nurse. Although she looks beautiful and could be mistaken for a model, her personality takes a 180 degrees turn during her private life. She is often misunderstood because of how harshly she treats other people, especially those that are not close to her. But in spite of that, she had the kindness to reach out to a depressed boy and save his heart, even if only a little.
